blocks.html: December 16, 2025 — Robinsons Supermarket proudly announces the relaunch of its Robinsons Galleria branch, unveiling a revitalized and modernized store designed to elevate the everyday grocery experience through thoughtful design, improved navigation, and an expanded wellness-focused assortment

The relaunched store features a more contemporary and welcoming look, highlighted by matcha-colored tiled columns that introduce a fresh visual identity throughout the space. A sleek, cool gray back wall anchors the meat and poultry section, creating a clean, premium backdrop that enhances product visibility and overall ambiance.

A dedicated wellness section is also reintroduced, featuring new, clearly defined categories that make it easier for shoppers to make informed, better-for-you choices. From Keto-friendly, Low-Sugar No Sugar, Gluten-Free, Organic, Fiber, Low Sodium to Beauty and Health Supplement categories – this new categorization of products was thoughtfully organized to support customers’ evolving health and lifestyle needs.

Expanded Assortment, Trusted Value
Robinsons Supermarket continues to offer a wide selection of farm-fresh produce and a diverse assortment of local and imported grocery staples trusted by Filipino families.
Recognizing the strong and growing communities of coffee enthusiasts and pet owners, the store now features:

items: An expanded coffee destination, offering a broader range of whole-bean, ground, instant, and specialty blends; convenient on-site coffee grinding services; and curated options for home brewers—from drip filters and French presses to premium single-origin selections.

A more comprehensive pet care zone, carrying an enriched assortment of pet food, treats, grooming products, and essential supplies for both dog and cat owners, addressing the increasing demand for high-quality pet nutrition and wellness products.

blocks.html: Customers can also enjoy more choices for quick, satisfying meals through the upgraded Food-to-Go section, which includes favorites from Uncle John’s and its newest offering Hearty Chicken Meal or the emerging crowd-favorite, the Hotdog Duo (a two 8-inch hotdog) among others. The store likewise highlights trusted exclusive brands such as Healthy Youand Meadows, offering quality alternatives at competitive prices.

Shoppers can maximize value with Robinsons Supermarket’s Everyday Low Price selections, PHP 50-pack vegetables, and the bi-monthly Red Super Savers promotions, featured prominently at the store highlighting products with at least 10% discounts on a rotating lineup of items.

This relaunch reinforces Robinsons Supermarket’s brand promise of “bringing goodness home” by empowering customers to make better choices—starting with the everyday decisions they make in the supermarket.

“This relaunch represents more than a renovated store—it reflects our commitment to making better choices more accessible to every Filipino family,” said Kerwin Legarde, Group General Manager of Robinsons Supermarket. “Through a modern store environment and a stronger focus on wellness, we are delivering on our promise to bring goodness home in a more meaningful and practical way for our customers.”

Robinsons Supermarket recently opened new stores and these stores also feature the brand’s modern store look. These initiatives are part of Robinsons Supermarket’s broader plan to relaunch several existing stores and open new locations in 2026.

Robinsons Supermarket is one of the Philippines’ leading supermarket chains, committed to delivering quality products, value, and convenience, while continuously evolving to meet the changing needs of Filipino households. Robinsons Supermarket is set to relaunch several stores and open new stores in 2026. To-date, Robinsons Supermarket has 156 stores nationwide.
